verdicts.reason: A turns the decorative circles into large discs that sit fully on the canvas instead of bleeding off the corners, and the GLACIER wordmark and the can now sit on top of the teal disc, so the background competes with the logo. A's legal line also floats in mid-air across the light-blue disc, with dead space below it. B keeps the logo and product on clean background and puts the legal text at the bottom, but its shrunken circles read as arbitrary floating dots. The teal disc almost touches the can's right green dot, and there is a large empty band between the CTA and the legal text.
